title: Stop With The Drawstring Bags!!
text: Stop With The Drawstring Bags!!. Packaging on all of this stuff ridiculous. Everything comes in a drawstring bag. What a waste. Anyway these gloves have potential if your hands are large enough. I have small hands and they don't fit well in the fingers ergo I don't have much claw control.  They work OK in loose mulch or soil as long as you keep pulling them up. Probably wouldn't buy them outright.
